title: Serum CHI3L1 levels correlate with disease activity in rheumatoid arthritis and reveal potential molecular mechanisms.
authors: Deng, Yi; Wang, Dan; Wang, Chao; Guo, Kaiyun; Lei, Ming; Huang, Yanzhao; Tang, Langui; Ding, Ya; Gao, Yan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究类风湿关节炎中CHI3L1表达与疾病活动度的关联，涉及转录因子网络和分子对接，但核心是临床生物标志物与免疫浸润分析，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作体系与结合机制建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: This study aims to elucidate the molecular regulatory mechanisms of Chitinase-3-like protein 1 (CHI3L1) in rheumatoid arthritis (RA) and its association with disease activity, focusing on its translational potential in RA diagnosis, dynamic monitoring, and precision therapy. METHODS: Transcriptomic datasets (GSE77298, GSE89408) and single-cell RNA-seq data (GSE200815) were obtained from Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO). CHI3L1 expression was analyzed by Wilcoxon test, and diagnostic accuracy by Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) curve. Single-cell analysis defined cell type-specific expression of CHI3L1. Differential analysis combined with weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) identified CHI3L1-related genes, followed by protein-protein interaction (PPI) and enrichment analyses. Immune infiltration was estimated with CIBERSORT, and competing endogenous RNA (ceRNA)/transcription factor networks were constructed to explore upstream regulation. Drug databases and molecular docking were integrated to predict therapeutic candidates. Clinically, serum CHI3L1 was measured by chemiluminescence immunoassay (CLIA) in RA patients (n=102) and controls (n=79), stratified by 28-joint Disease Activity Score with erythrocyte sedimentation rate (DAS28-ESR), and correlated with C-reactive protein (CRP), rheumatoid factor (RF), anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody (CCP), and ESR. RESULTS: CHI3L1 expression was significantly higher in RA across datasets (P<0.01) with strong diagnostic performance (AUC>0.8). Single-cell analysis revealed predominant fibroblast expression. Integrated analysis identified 51 candidate genes, enriched in chemokine signaling and mineral absorption pathways. PPI analysis highlighted TIMP1 and AQP9 as key genes, both strongly correlated with CHI3L1 (r>0, P<0.001). Immune infiltration showed increased M0 macrophages and plasma cells, reduced regulatory T cells, and significant correlations with CHI3L1. The ceRNA network indicated involvement of multiple miRNAs and lncRNAs. Drug prediction identified glibenclamide with the lowest binding energy (-9.386 kcal/mol). Clinically, serum CHI3L1 was markedly elevated in RA (P<0.001) with excellent diagnostic accuracy (AUC = 0.907). Higher CHI3L1 levels were observed in high-activity patients (P<0.01). CHI3L1 correlated with CRP (r=0.40, P<0.001), ESR (r=0.35, P<0.001), and moderately with CCP (r=0.21, P<0.05). CONCLUSION: This exploratory study suggests that CHI3L1 is a fibroblast-enriched molecule closely associated with immune dysregulation and RA activity, showing promise as a diagnostic and monitoring biomarker and a potential therapeutic target, though further validation through functional experiments and prospective studies is warranted.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在阐明几丁质酶-3样蛋白1（CHI3L1）在类风湿关节炎（RA）中的分子调控机制及其与疾病活动度的关联，重点关注其在RA诊断、动态监测和精准治疗中的转化潜力。方法：从基因表达综合数据库（GEO）获取转录组数据集（GSE77298、GSE89408）和单细胞RNA测序数据（GSE200815）。采用Wilcoxon检验分析CHI3L1表达，并通过受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线评估诊断准确性。单细胞分析定义了CHI3L1的细胞类型特异性表达。差异分析结合加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）鉴定CHI3L1相关基因，随后进行蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）和富集分析。利用CIBERSORT估计免疫浸润，并构建竞争性内源RNA（ceRNA）/转录因子网络以探索上游调控。整合药物数据库和分子对接预测治疗候选药物。临床上，采用化学发光免疫分析法（CLIA）检测RA患者（n=102）和对照组（n=79）的血清CHI3L1，按28关节疾病活动度评分-红细胞沉降率（DAS28-ESR）分层，并与C反应蛋白（CRP）、类风湿因子（RF）、抗环瓜氨酸肽抗体（CCP）和ESR进行相关性分析。结果：CHI3L1表达在各数据集的RA中显著升高（P<0.01），且具有强诊断性能（AUC>0.8）。单细胞分析显示其主要在成纤维细胞中表达。整合分析鉴定出51个候选基因，富集于趋化因子信号和矿物质吸收通路。PPI分析突出TIMP1和AQP9为关键基因，两者均与CHI3L1强相关（r>0，P<0.001）。免疫浸润显示M0巨噬细胞和浆细胞增加，调节性T细胞减少，并与CHI3L1显著相关。ceRNA网络提示多种miRNA和lncRNA的参与。药物预测鉴定出格列本脲具有最低结合能（-9.386 kcal/mol）。临床上，RA患者血清CHI3L1显著升高（P<0.001），诊断准确性优异（AUC = 0.907）。高活动度患者中观察到更高的CHI3L1水平（P<0.01）。CHI3L1与CRP（r=0.40，P<0.001）、ESR（r=0.35，P<0.001）相关，并与CCP中度相关（r=0.21，P<0.05）。结论：本探索性研究表明，CHI3L1是一种成纤维细胞富集分子，与免疫失调和RA活动度密切相关，有望作为诊断和监测生物标志物及潜在治疗靶点，但仍需通过功能实验和前瞻性研究进一步验证。
